name: OPNsense-Exporter
description: OPNsense Exporter - Prometheus exporter for OPNsense firewalls. Collects and exposes metrics from OPNsense via its REST API, including ARP tables, DNS (Unbound), WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, firewall statistics, and firmware information.

ports.name: Metrics Port
ports.description: Port on which the /metrics endpoint is exposed for Prometheus scraping.

variables.name: OPNsense Protocol
variables.description: Protocol used to reach the OPNsense API. Use 'https' (recommended) or 'http'.

variables.name: OPNsense Address
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the OPNsense firewall (e.g. 192.168.1.1 or opnsense.lan). Do NOT include the protocol prefix.

variables.name: OPNsense API Key
variables.description: API key generated for the read-only OPNsense user (System > Access > Users).

variables.name: OPNsense API Secret
variables.description: API secret generated for the read-only OPNsense user (System > Access > Users).

variables.name: Skip TLS Verification
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable TLS certificate verification (useful for self-signed certs). Not recommended in production.

variables.name: Instance Label
variables.description: Label added to all metrics to identify this OPNsense instance. Useful when scraping multiple firewalls.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log verbosity. Options: debug, info, warn, error.

variables.name: Disable ARP Table
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable ARP table metric collection.

variables.name: Disable Unbound DNS
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable Unbound DNS metric collection.

variables.name: Disable WireGuard
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable WireGuard VPN metric collection.

variables.name: Disable OpenVPN
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable OpenVPN metric collection.

variables.name: Disable IPsec
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable IPsec VPN metric collection.

variables.name: Disable Firewall
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable firewall statistics metric collection.

variables.name: Disable Firmware
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable firmware information metric collection.

variables.name: Disable Cron Table
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable cron task metric collection.

variables.name: Disable Exporter Metrics
variables.description: Set to 'true' to exclude internal Go/process metrics from the /metrics output.
